notes: SuccessFactors RMK / Jobs2Web portal at jobs.inspirededu.com — search is AJAX-loaded, so discovery reads sitemap.xml and keeps /job/<City>/<id>/ URLs whose city maps to IST cantons (TI/GR). seedUrls are stable location entry points, not per-job URLs (those 404 once a posting is filled). IST often has zero live TI/GR openings, in which case the crawler legitimately keeps existing data with no error.
